caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged in a triangular formation on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is an oval-shaped buckle outlined with a series of blue circular elements and a metallic interior structure. Below it, slightly to the left, is another oval buckle, which is adorned with light purple circular elements along its perimeter and also features a metallic interior. To the right of the lower buckle, there is a side-view illustration of the top buckle, showing its curvature and the blue elements along its edge. The image features no additional backgrounds or decorative elements, except for the artist's signature "WALTc–nK" in the bottom left corner.
title: Neck Buckle
